goal:
Inputs:
  nums: list[int]
Assumptions:
  h_precond: FindSingleNumber_precond(nums)
Find result: int
such that FindSingleNumber_postcond(nums, result, h_precond)

lemmas.name: fl_eq
lemmas.statement: forall (x: int), (l: list[int]): filterlist(x, l) == l.filter(lambda y: bool(y == x))
lemmas.proof:
by intro x l
  unfold filterlist
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [filterlist.aux]
  | cons y ys ih => simp only [filterlist.aux, List.filter_cons, ih]; split_ifs <;> simp_all

lemmas.name: fl_count
lemmas.statement: forall (l: list[int]), (y: int): len(l.filter(lambda z: bool(z == y))) == l.count(y)
lemmas.proof:
by intro l y
  rw [List.count_eq_length_filter]
  rfl

lemmas.name: pair_le_countP
lemmas.statement: forall (l: list[int]), (p: int ==> bool), (x: int), (r: int): x != r ==> p(x) == True ==> p(r) == True ==> len(l.filter(lambda y: bool(y == x))) + len(l.filter(lambda y: bool(y == r))) <= l.count_if(p)
lemmas.proof:
by intro l p x r hxr hx hr
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    by_cases hax : a = x
    · subst hax
      have : ¬ a = r := hxr
      simp [List.filter_cons, List.countP_cons, this, hx]; omega
    · by_cases har : a = r
      · subst har
        simp [List.filter_cons, List.countP_cons, hax, hr]; omega
      · simp [List.filter_cons, List.countP_cons, hax, har]; split_ifs <;> omega

lemmas.name: single1
lemmas.statement: forall (nums: list[int]), (h: FindSingleNumber_precond(nums)): FindSingleNumber_postcond(nums, nums.find?(lambda x: bool(nums.count(x) == 1)).get_or(0), h)
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums h
  unfold FindSingleNumber_postcond
  obtain ⟨hall, hcnt⟩ := h
  have h1mem : 1 ∈ nums.map (fun x => nums.count x) := List.count_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0, hc0⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h1mem
  have hany : nums.any (fun x => decide (nums.count x = 1)) = true := List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨x0, hx0, by simpa using hc0⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrmem, hp⟩ := Refine.find_some_of_any nums _ hany
  have hcr : nums.count r = 1 := of_decide_eq_true hp
  have e : (nums.find? (fun x => decide (nums.count x = 1))).getD 0 = r := by rw [hr]; rfl
  rw [e]
  have hflen : ∀ y, (filterlist y nums).length = nums.count y := by
    intro y; rw [fl_eq]; exact fl_count nums y
  refine ⟨List.length_pos_of_mem hrmem, by rw [hflen, hcr], ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  by_cases hxr : x = r
  · exact Or.inl hxr
  · right
    rw [hflen]
    have hx12 := List.all_eq_true.mp hall _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hx12
    rcases hx12 with h1 | h2
    · exfalso
      have := pair_le_countP nums (fun y => decide (nums.count y = 1)) x r hxr (by simpa using h1) (by simpa using hcr)
      have hc : (nums.map (fun x => nums.count x)).count 1 = nums.countP (fun y => decide (nums.count y = 1)) := by
        rw [List.count_eq_countP, List.countP_map]; rfl
      have hxl : (nums.filter (fun y => decide (y = x))).length = 1 := by rw [fl_count]; exact h1
      have hrl : (nums.filter (fun y => decide (y = r))).length = 1 := by rw [fl_count]; exact hcr
      omega
    · exact h2

goal:
Inputs:
  n: nat
  primes: list[nat]
Assumptions:
  h_precond: findExponents_precond(n, primes)
Find result: list[tuple[nat, nat]]
such that findExponents_postcond(n, primes, result, h_precond)

lemmas.name: rpf_eq
lemmas.statement: forall (p: nat): p.Prime ==> (forall (n: nat): 0 < n ==> removePrimeFactor(n, p) == n / p ** padicValNat(p, n))
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro p hp
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro hn
    rw [removePrimeFactor]
    have hp1 : p > 1 := hp.one_lt
    rw [dif_pos ⟨hp1, hn⟩]
    haveI := Fact.mk hp
    by_cases hd : n % p = 0
    · rw [if_pos hd]
      have hdv : p ∣ n := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hd
      have hlt : n / p < n := Nat.div_lt_self hn hp1
      have hpos : 0 < n / p := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hn hdv) (by omega)
      rw [ih (n / p) hlt hpos]
      have hv : padicValNat p n = padicValNat p (n / p) + 1 := by
        have h1 : n = p * (n / p) := (Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdv).symm
        conv_lhs => rw [h1]
        rw [padicValNat.mul (by omega) (by omega), padicValNat_self]; omega
      rw [hv, pow_succ', Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]
    · rw [if_neg hd]
      have : padicValNat p n = 0 := padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd (by
        intro h; exact hd (Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h))
      simp [this]

lemmas.name: rpf_dvd
lemmas.statement: forall (p: nat): p.Prime ==> (forall (n: nat): 0 < n ==> p ** padicValNat(p, n) * removePrimeFactor(n, p) == n)
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro p hp n hn
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  rw [rpf_eq p hp n hn]
  exact Nat.mul_div_cancel' pow_padicValNat_dvd

lemmas.name: fold_mul
lemmas.statement: forall (l: list[tuple[nat, nat]]), (a: nat): l.foldl(lambda acc, (x: tuple[nat, nat]): acc * x.1 ** x.2, a) == a * l.foldl(lambda acc, (x: tuple[nat, nat]): acc * x.1 ** x.2, 1)
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons x t ih => intro a; simp only [List.foldl_cons]; rw [ih (a * x.1 ^ x.2), ih (1 * x.1 ^ x.2)]; ring

lemmas.name: fe_main
lemmas.statement: forall (ps: list[nat]), (n: nat): 0 < n ==> (forall p in ps: p.Prime) ==> ps.Nodup ==> ps.foldl(removePrimeFactor, n) == 1 ==> n == ps.map(lambda p: (p, padicValNat(p, n))).foldl(lambda acc, (x: tuple[nat, nat]): acc * x.1 ** x.2, 1)
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro ps
  induction ps with
  | nil => intro n hn _ _ h; simp at h ⊢; exact h
  | cons p qs ih =>
    intro n hn hprime hnd h
    have hp : p.Prime := hprime p List.mem_cons_self
    have hqs : ∀ q ∈ qs, q.Prime := fun q hq => hprime q (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hq)
    have hnd' := List.nodup_cons.mp hnd
    haveI := Fact.mk hp
    have hdiv := rpf_dvd p hp n hn
    have hn' : 0 < removePrimeFactor n p := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (removePrimeFactor n p) with h0 | h0
      · rw [h0] at hdiv; omega
      · exact h0
    have hfold : qs.foldl removePrimeFactor (removePrimeFactor n p) = 1 := by simpa [List.foldl_cons] using h
    have h1 := ih (removePrimeFactor n p) hn' hqs hnd'.2 hfold
    have hval : ∀ q ∈ qs, padicValNat q (removePrimeFactor n p) = padicValNat q n := by
      intro q hq
      haveI := Fact.mk (hqs q hq)
      have hqp : q ≠ p := fun e => hnd'.1 (e ▸ hq)
      have : padicValNat q n = padicValNat q (p ^ padicValNat p n) + padicValNat q (removePrimeFactor n p) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← hdiv]
        exact padicValNat.mul (pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero) (by omega)
      rw [this, padicValNat.pow p (padicValNat p n), padicValNat_primes hqp]; simp
    have hmap : (qs.map (fun q => (q, padicValNat q n))) = (qs.map (fun q => (q, padicValNat q (removePrimeFactor n p)))) :=
      List.map_congr_left (fun q hq => by rw [hval q hq])
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.foldl_cons]
    rw [hmap, fold_mul, ← h1]
    simp only [one_mul]
    exact hdiv.symm

lemmas.name: exps10
lemmas.statement: forall (n: nat), (primes: list[nat]), (h: findExponents_precond(n, primes)): findExponents_postcond(n, primes, primes.map(lambda p: (p, padicValNat(p, n))), h)
lemmas.proof:
by intro n primes h
  obtain ⟨hn, _, hprime, hnd, hrem⟩ := h
  unfold findExponents_postcond
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fe_main primes n hn (fun p hp => by simpa using List.all_eq_true.mp hprime p hp) hnd hrem
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro x hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    simpa using hp
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro p hp
    rw [List.any_eq_true]
    exact ⟨(p, padicValNat p n), List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, by simp⟩

goal:
Inputs:
  lst: list[int]
Assumptions:
  h_precond: findMajorityElement_precond(lst)
Find result: int
such that findMajorityElement_postcond(lst, result, h_precond)

step.expr: lst.find?(lambda x: bool(len(lst.filter(lambda y: y == x)) > len(lst) / 2)).get_or(-1)

lemmas.name: maj11
lemmas.statement: forall (lst: list[int]), (h: findMajorityElement_precond(lst)), (res: int): (forall x: x in lst ==> len(lst.filter(lambda y: y == x)) <= len(lst) / 2) and res == (-1) or len(lst.filter(lambda y: y == res)) > len(lst) / 2 ==> findMajorityElement_postcond(lst, res, h)
lemmas.proof:
by intro lst h res hc
  unfold findMajorityElement_postcond
  dsimp only
  rcases hc with ⟨hall, hres⟩ | hmaj
  · exact ⟨fun _ => Or.inl (List.all_eq_true.mpr fun x hx => by simpa using hall x hx), fun hne => absurd hres hne⟩
  · have hmaj' : (lst.filter (fun y => y = res)).length > lst.length / 2 ∧ lst.all (fun x => decide ((lst.filter (fun y => y = x)).length ≤ lst.length / 2 ∨ x = res)) = true := by
      refine ⟨hmaj, List.all_eq_true.mpr fun x hx => ?_⟩
      by_cases hxr : x = res
      · simp [hxr]
      · have := Refine.filter_pair_le lst x res hxr
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]; left; omega
    exact ⟨fun _ => Or.inr hmaj', fun _ => hmaj'⟩

lemmas.name: find11
lemmas.statement: forall (lst: list[int]), (h: findMajorityElement_precond(lst)): findMajorityElement_postcond(lst, lst.find?(lambda x: bool(len(lst.filter(lambda y: y == x)) > len(lst) / 2)).get_or(-1), h)
lemmas.proof:
by intro lst h
  apply maj11 lst h
  cases hf : lst.find? (fun x => decide ((lst.filter (fun y => y = x)).length > lst.length / 2)) with
  | none =>
    left
    refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
    intro x hx
    have := List.find?_eq_none.mp hf x hx
    simpa using this
  | some r =>
    right
    simp only [Option.getD_some]
    have hp := List.find?_some hf
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hp
    exact hp

goal:
Inputs:
  lst: list[int]
Assumptions:
  h_precond: firstDuplicate_precond(lst)
Find result: option[int]
such that firstDuplicate_postcond(lst, result, h_precond)

step.expr: match lst.filter(lambda y: bool(lst.count(y) > 1)) with | [] => none | b :: t => some((b :: t).foldl(lambda best, y: y if secondOccIdx(lst, y) < secondOccIdx(lst, best) else best, b))

lemmas.name: argmin_facts
lemmas.statement: forall {α: Type}, (f: α ==> nat), (L: list[α]), (b: α): (L.foldl(lambda best, y: y if f(y) < f(best) else best, b) == b or L.foldl(lambda best, y: y if f(y) < f(best) else best, b) in L) and f(L.foldl(lambda best, y: y if f(y) < f(best) else best, b)) <= f(b) and (forall y in L: f(L.foldl(lambda best, y: y if f(y) < f(best) else best, b)) <= f(y))
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro α f L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro b; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro b
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    by_cases hlt : f a < f b
    · rw [if_pos hlt]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih a
      refine ⟨?_, by omega, ?_⟩
      · rcases h1 with h | h
        · right; rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons_self
        · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a h
      · intro x hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
        · exact h2
        · exact h3 x hx'
    · rw [if_neg hlt]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih b
      refine ⟨?_, h2, ?_⟩
      · rcases h1 with h | h
        · left; exact h
        · right; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a h
      · intro x hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
        · omega
        · exact h3 x hx'

lemmas.name: first12
lemmas.statement: forall (lst: list[int]), (h: firstDuplicate_precond(lst)): firstDuplicate_postcond(lst, match lst.filter(lambda y: bool(lst.count(y) > 1)) with | [] => none | b :: t => some((b :: t).foldl(lambda best, y: y if secondOccIdx(lst, y) < secondOccIdx(lst, best) else best, b)), h)
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro lst h
  unfold firstDuplicate_postcond
  cases hL : lst.filter (fun y => decide (lst.count y > 1)) with
  | nil =>
    show List.Nodup lst
    rw [List.nodup_iff_count_le_one]
    intro a
    by_contra hgt
    have hmem : a ∈ lst.filter (fun y => decide (lst.count y > 1)) :=
      List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨List.count_pos_iff.mp (by omega), by simpa using (by omega : lst.count a > 1)⟩
    rw [hL] at hmem
    simp at hmem
  | cons b t =>
    show lst.count ((b :: t).foldl (fun best y => if secondOccIdx lst y < secondOccIdx lst best then y else best) b) > 1 ∧ _
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := argmin_facts (secondOccIdx lst) (b :: t) b
    have hmem : (b :: t).foldl (fun best y => if secondOccIdx lst y < secondOccIdx lst best then y else best) b ∈ b :: t := by
      rcases h1 with h | h
      · rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons_self
      · exact h
    generalize (b :: t).foldl (fun best y => if secondOccIdx lst y < secondOccIdx lst best then y else best) b = r at h1 h2 h3 hmem ⊢
    have hfm : r ∈ lst.filter (fun y => decide (lst.count y > 1)) := by rw [hL]; exact hmem
    refine ⟨of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.mp hfm).2, ?_⟩
    rw [List.all_eq_true]
    intro y hy
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    by_cases hy1 : lst.count y = 1
    · exact Or.inl hy1
    · right
      have hpos : 0 < lst.count y := List.count_pos_iff.mpr hy
      have hym : y ∈ b :: t := by
        rw [← hL]
        exact List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hy, by simpa using (by omega : lst.count y > 1)⟩
      exact h3 y hym

goal:
Inputs:
  N: nat
  chords: list[list[nat]]
Assumptions:
  h_precond: hasChordIntersection_precond(N, chords)
Find result: bool
such that hasChordIntersection_postcond(N, chords, result, h_precond)

step.expr: let sortedChords = chords.map(lambda chord: let a = chord[0]; let b = chord[1]; [b, a] if a > b else [a, b]); sortedChords.any(lambda x: sortedChords.any(lambda y: hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection(x, y)))

lemmas.name: has_symm13
lemmas.statement: forall (x: list[nat]), (y: list[nat]): hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection(x, y) == hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection(y, x)
lemmas.proof:
by intro x y
  unfold hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection
  exact Bool.or_comm _ _

lemmas.name: has_irr13
lemmas.statement: forall (x: list[nat]): hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection(x, x) == False
lemmas.proof:
by intro x
  unfold hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection
  simp

lemmas.name: chord13
lemmas.statement: forall (N: nat), (chords: list[list[nat]]), (h: hasChordIntersection_precond(N, chords)): hasChordIntersection_postcond(N, chords, let sortedChords = chords.map(lambda chord: let a = chord[0]; let b = chord[1]; [b, a] if a > b else [a, b]); sortedChords.any(lambda x: sortedChords.any(lambda y: hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection(x, y))), h)
lemmas.proof:
by intro N chords h
  unfold hasChordIntersection_postcond
  intro sortedChords
  refine ⟨fun hpw hres => ?_, fun hany => hany⟩
  have hres' : (sortedChords.any (fun x => sortedChords.any (fun y => hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection x y))) = true := hres
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hy'⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp hres'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp hy'
  by_cases hxe : x = y
  · subst hxe; rw [has_irr13] at hxy; exact absurd hxy (by simp)
  · haveI : Std.Symm (fun a b : List Nat => (!hasChordIntersection_postcond.hasIntersection a b) = true) := ⟨fun a b h => by simpa [has_symm13 a b] using h⟩
    have hpw' := List.Pairwise.forall hpw hx hy hxe
    simp [hxy] at hpw'

goal:
Inputs:
  n: nat
Assumptions:
  h_precond: ifPowerOfFour_precond(n)
Find result: bool
such that ifPowerOfFour_postcond(n, result, h_precond)

lemmas.name: pow4_iff
lemmas.statement: forall (n: nat): (exists (m: nat): n == 4 ** m) <==> range(n + 1).any(lambda m: bool(n == 4 ** m)) == True
lemmas.proof:
by intro n
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    rw [List.any_eq_true]
    have hlt : m < 4 ^ m := Nat.lt_pow_self (by omega)
    refine ⟨m, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by simpa using hm⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨m, _, hm⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp h
    exact ⟨m, by simpa using hm⟩

lemmas.name: pow4_ok
lemmas.statement: forall (n: nat), (h: ifPowerOfFour_precond(n)): ifPowerOfFour_postcond(n, range(n + 1).any(lambda m: bool(n == 4 ** m)), h)
lemmas.proof:
by intro n h
  unfold ifPowerOfFour_postcond
  exact (pow4_iff n).symm

lemmas.name: trip15
lemmas.statement: forall (nums: list[int]), (h: increasingTriplet_precond(nums)): increasingTriplet_postcond(nums, let nums' = nums.zipIdx; nums'.any(lambda (x, i): nums'.any(lambda (y, j): nums'.any(lambda (z, k): bool(i < j and j < k and x < y and y < z)))), h)

Inputs:
  a: array[int]
  b: array[int]
Assumptions:
  h_precond: LongestCommonSubsequence_precond(a, b)
Find result: int
such that LongestCommonSubsequence_postcond(a, b, result, h_precond)

by
  intro m1 m2 h
  obtain ⟨hn1, hn2⟩ := h
  have hperm := List.mergeSort_perm ((m1.entries.filter (fun p => !(m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == p.1)))) ++ m2.entries)
    (fun a b => decide (a.1 ≤ b.1))
  generalize hS : ((m1.entries.filter (fun p => !(m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == p.1)))) ++ m2.entries).mergeSort
      (fun a b => decide (a.1 ≤ b.1)) = S at hperm
  have hkeys : ((m1.entries.filter (fun p => !(m2.entries.any (fun q => q.1 == p.1)))) ++ m2.entries).map Prod.fst |>.Nodup := by
    rw [List.map_append, List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨?_, hn2, ?_⟩
    · exact (hn1.sublist (List.Sublist.map _ (List.filter_sublist)))
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      subst hab
      obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
      have := (List.mem_filter.mp hp).2
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqe⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hb
      have : (m2.entries.any (fun q' => q'.1 == p.1)) = true :=
        List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨q, hq, by simp [hqe]⟩

  have hSkeys : (S.map Prod.fst).Nodup := (hperm.map Prod.fst).nodup_iff.mpr hkeys
  have hsorted : List.Pairwise (fun a b => decide (a.1 ≤ b.1) = true) S := by
    rw [← hS]
    exact List.pairwise_mergeSort (by intro a b c h1 h2; simp at *; omega) (by intro a b; simp; omega) _
  have hfind : ∀ x, x ∈ S → find? (⟨S⟩ : Map Int Int) x.1 = some x.2 := by
    intro x hx
    show (S.find? (fun p => p.1 == x.1)).map (·.2) = some x.2
    rw [find_key S hSkeys x hx]; rfl
  unfold update_map_postcond
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hsorted.imp (fun h => by simpa using h)
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro x hx
    have hxS : x ∈ S := hperm.mem_iff.mpr (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hx))
    exact decide_eq_true (hfind x hxS)
  · rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro x hx
    show (match (m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == x.1)).map (·.2) with

      | none => decide (find? (⟨S⟩ : Map Int Int) x.1 = some x.2)) = true

    | some y => simp

      simpa using decide_eq_true (hfind x hxS)

    have hyU := hperm.mem_iff.mp hy

      | some v => (match (m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1)).map (·.2) with
        | some v' => decide (y.2 = v')
        | none => decide (y.2 = v))
      | none => decide ((m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1)).map (·.2) = some y.2)) = true

    · obtain ⟨hy1, hnoany⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hf
      have h1 : m1.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1) = some y := find_key m1.entries hn1 y hy1

      have h2 : m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1) = none :=
        List.find?_eq_none.mpr (fun q hq hqy => by
          have := List.any_eq_false.mp hany q hq
          exact this hqy)
      rw [h1, h2]; simp
    · have h2 : m2.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1) = some y := find_key m2.entries hn2 y hm2
      rw [h2]
      cases h1 : m1.entries.find? (fun p => p.1 == y.1) <;> simp

  intro s h

  dsimp only
  generalize s.toList = cs

  | none =>
    show List.Pairwise (· ≠ ·) cs
    have hnone := List.find?_eq_none.mp hf
    have := nodup_of_no_rep cs cs.length (le_refl _) (fun i hi => by
      have := hnone i (List.mem_range.mpr hi)
      simpa using this)
    simpa using this
  | some i =>
    show _ ∧ _
    obtain ⟨hp0, k, hk, hki, hbefore⟩ := List.find?_eq_some_iff_getElem.mp hf

    subst hki
    have hi : k < cs.length := by simpa using hk
    have hp : cs[k]! ∈ cs.take k := by simpa using hp0
    have hmin : ∀ j, j < k → cs[j]! ∉ cs.take j := by

      have h' : decide (cs[j]! ∈ cs.take j) = true := decide_eq_true hmem
      rw [h'] at this
      simp at this
    have hnd := nodup_of_no_rep cs k (by omega) hmin
    obtain ⟨c, hcs⟩ : ∃ c, cs[k]? = some c := ⟨cs[k], List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi⟩

    have hckk : cs[k] = c := by
      have := hcs; rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi] at this; exact Option.some.inj this

    have hp1 : cs.idxOf c < k := by

      have hjs : j < cs.length := by omega
      have h1 : cs[j]? = some c := by
        rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hjs]; simp at hjc; simp [hjc]
      have := idxOf_le_of_getElem_c cs j c h1
      omega
    have hidx : cs.zipIdx.findIdx (fun (x, i) => x = c && i ≠ cs.idxOf c) = k := by
      rw [List.findIdx_eq (by simpa using hi)]
      constructor
      · simp only [List.getElem_zipIdx, hckk]
        simp; omega
      · intro j hj
        simp only [List.getElem_zipIdx]
        have hjl : j < cs.length := by omega
        by_cases hc : cs[j] = c
        · have hcj : cs[j]? = some c := by rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hjl, hc]

        rw [List.mem_iff_getElem]

    rw [hidx]; exact hnd

lemmas.proof:

  | nil => intro x y _ _ _; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x y hx hy h
    by_cases hax : a = x
    · subst hax
      by_cases hpa : p a = true
      · simp [List.filter_cons, hpa]
      · exact absurd hx hpa
    · by_cases hay : a = y
      · subst hay
        have : (a :: t).idxOf a = 0 := List.idxOf_cons_self
        have h2 : (a :: t).idxOf x = (t.idxOf x) + 1 := by simp [List.idxOf_cons, hax]

    intro hev
